Ray_Finned_Pectorals.description: Flexible webs of skin supported by bony spines (lepidotrichia). Unlike rigid shark fins, they can be precisely folded, rippled, and articulated to provide unparalleled low-speed maneuverability, reversing, and dead-stops.

Spined_Dorsal_Stabilizer.description: A towering, rigid dorsal fin designed to prevent the entity from completely rolling over during high-speed turns. Its leading edges are lined with hollow, venom-injecting spines as a ultimate deterrent against attacks from above.
